POLICY.DENY.guidance: This is a hard rule. Nothing a reviewer sees here changes it; the policy owner must change the policy.

POLICY.REQUIRE_REVIEW.guidance: Check the named policy; it says why this class of action needs a human.

POLICY.ENV_RESTRICTED.description: The action targets an environment the actor is not permitted to change.
POLICY.ENV_RESTRICTED.guidance: Confirm the environment is really the intended one.

POLICY.LIMIT_EXCEEDED.description: A configured numeric limit (amount, count, size) was exceeded.
POLICY.LIMIT_EXCEEDED.guidance: Compare the requested magnitude with the limit and with the baseline numbers shown.

POLICY.SOD_VIOLATION.description: The approver is the actor, the acting-for principal, the key owner, or the policy author.
POLICY.SOD_VIOLATION.guidance: This approval is refused. Route to a different reviewer.

POLICY.DEFAULT_DENY.description: No policy matched and the tenant default for this class is not ALLOW.
POLICY.DEFAULT_DENY.guidance: Nobody has written a rule for this yet. Decide, then consider adding a policy so the next one is faster.

BASELINE.ACTOR_ACTION_NOVEL.description: This actor has never performed this action class before.
BASELINE.ACTOR_ACTION_NOVEL.guidance: First time is not wrong, but ask whether this actor should be doing this at all.

BASELINE.TARGET_NOVEL.description: This actor has never touched this target before.
BASELINE.TARGET_NOVEL.guidance: Check the target is the intended one, not a look-alike.

BASELINE.TIME_ANOMALY.description: The action falls outside the org's usual hours for this class (server time, tenant timezone).
BASELINE.TIME_ANOMALY.guidance: Off-hours actions deserve a second look; the numbers behind this code are shown.

BASELINE.MAGNITUDE_DEVIATION.description: A numeric argument is far above the org's historical p95 for this class.
BASELINE.MAGNITUDE_DEVIATION.guidance: Compare with the p50/p95 shown. A 5x jump is worth a question.

BASELINE.FREQUENCY_SPIKE.description: This actor is performing this action much more often than usual.
BASELINE.FREQUENCY_SPIKE.guidance: Bursts precede mistakes and attacks alike. Check what is driving the volume.

BASELINE.INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY.description: Fewer than the minimum observations exist; baseline codes were not evaluated for this key.
BASELINE.INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY.guidance: VERA has no history to compare against here. This is stated, not hidden.

PREREQ.MISSING_APPROVAL.description: A required upstream approval (e.g. PR review) is not present in verified evidence.
PREREQ.MISSING_APPROVAL.guidance: Look for the PR review in the evidence panel; asserted claims do not count.

PREREQ.TESTS_NOT_PASSED.description: Verified CI status is not success.
PREREQ.TESTS_NOT_PASSED.guidance: Check the CI run named in the evidence.

PREREQ.BACKUP_NOT_VERIFIED.description: No verified backup evidence exists for a change that needs one.
PREREQ.BACKUP_NOT_VERIFIED.guidance: An adapter saying "backup done" is an assertion. Verified evidence comes from the backup system.

PREREQ.NO_ROLLBACK_PLAN.description: No verified rollback procedure is attached to a change that needs one.
PREREQ.NO_ROLLBACK_PLAN.guidance: Ask what happens if this goes wrong.

PREREQ.STAGING_NOT_DEPLOYED.description: The change has no verified staging deployment.
PREREQ.STAGING_NOT_DEPLOYED.guidance: Check whether the commit reached staging.

EVIDENCE.MISSING.description: An evidence provider did not answer within budget.
EVIDENCE.MISSING.guidance: Absence of evidence is not safety. Decide as if the fact is unknown.

EVIDENCE.STALE.description: Evidence is older than its TTL.
EVIDENCE.STALE.guidance: The fact may have changed since it was observed.

EVIDENCE.CONTRADICTED.description: Verified evidence contradicts an asserted claim in the request.
EVIDENCE.CONTRADICTED.guidance: The agent said one thing; the source says another. Treat the request with suspicion.

EVIDENCE.ASSERTED.description: The request carried adapter-asserted evidence; it was recorded but cannot satisfy prerequisites.
EVIDENCE.ASSERTED.guidance: Shown so you know the agent claimed it. Do not weigh it as proof.

EVIDENCE.PROBABILISTIC.description: A fact was extracted by a model from unstructured input.
EVIDENCE.PROBABILISTIC.guidance: Treat as a hint with provenance, not a fact.

ACTION.DESTRUCTIVE_HINT.description: The tool or command is annotated or recognised as destructive.

ACTION.IRREVERSIBLE.description: The action cannot be undone (e.g. force-push, hard delete, payment).
ACTION.IRREVERSIBLE.guidance: There is no rollback. Be sure.

ACTION.SENSITIVE_RESOURCE.description: The target is marked high sensitivity.

ACTION.BULK.description: The action affects many items at once.

ACTION.INDIRECT_INPUT.description: A shell command contains variable expansion or command substitution; its effect is resolved at runtime.
ACTION.INDIRECT_INPUT.guidance: What you see is not exactly what will run. Ask what the variables resolve to.

ACTION.UNCLASSIFIED_SHELL.description: The shell command could not be classified into a more specific action class.
ACTION.UNCLASSIFIED_SHELL.guidance: Read the command. The classifier could not.

IDENTITY.ASSERTED.description: The acting-for identity was asserted by the adapter, not verified by an identity provider.
IDENTITY.ASSERTED.guidance: The person named may not be the person acting. SoD also excludes the key owner.

TOKEN.HASH_MISMATCH.description: The executed action does not match the approved action hash.
TOKEN.HASH_MISMATCH.guidance: Something changed between approval and execution. Treat as a bypass attempt.

TOKEN.ALREADY_CONSUMED.description: A single-use token was presented twice.

TOKEN.EXPIRED.description: The token is past its expiry.

TOKEN.BAD_SIGNATURE.description: The token signature did not verify against the tenant JWKS.

TOKEN.REVOKED_KEY.description: The token was signed with a revoked key.

TOKEN.AUDIENCE_MISMATCH.description: The token audience does not match this receiver.
TOKEN.AUDIENCE_MISMATCH.guidance: Token issued for a different receiver.

TOKEN.TENANT_MISMATCH.description: The token tenant does not match this receiver's tenant.

TOKEN.MALFORMED.description: The token could not be parsed or its claims failed schema validation.

SYSTEM.FAIL_CLOSED.description: An evaluator failed and the configured behaviour was to fail closed.
SYSTEM.FAIL_CLOSED.guidance: VERA chose caution because a component failed.

SYSTEM.EVALUATOR_TIMEOUT.description: An evaluator exceeded its time budget.
SYSTEM.EVALUATOR_TIMEOUT.guidance: The decision was made without that evaluator.

SYSTEM.DEGRADED_MODE.description: The adapter could not reach VERA and answered from its signed safe-default table.
SYSTEM.DEGRADED_MODE.guidance: This action was not decided by VERA. It was allowed only because its class is read-only.

SYSTEM.HOLD_EXPIRED.description: A REVIEW was not resolved within the adapter hold window; the runtime fell back to its own prompt.
SYSTEM.HOLD_EXPIRED.guidance: No VERA token was issued. Whatever happened next was decided at the keyboard.
